item.title: Best Smart Plugs to Eliminate Standby Power Drain
item.description:

Quick Answer

Smart plugs cut phantom loads — but only if you measure first. Standby power costs the average US household roughly $100–$200 a year (5–10% of residential electricity use). The must-have feature is energy monitoring: find the multi-watt offenders clustered at entertainment centers and home offices, then let schedules cut them automatically. Realistic savings run $50–$150 a year; a $30 four-pack aimed at the right targets breaks even around month six.
